result.topic_en: Scratch calculations: identities for bilinear expressions of the form xη+yζ−(z+x+η)(z+ζ+y) under substitution with parameters α, β, γ, combinatorial lists of letter-index pairings (ab, cd, ef, g1…g4, as for theta characteristics or pairs of branch points), cross-ratio tables with values 0, ∞, 1, k, and solving a small linear system for v, v′, v″ with square-root expressions λ, λ′, λ″ in k.
